pages.text: Keep oil in the main inventory. A successful melee weapon hit against its category gains +15% damage and uses one of 40 charges. No free offhand required. Multiplies with matching elixir.

Lowest slot wins; oils do not stack. Misses, blocked hits and no HP loss use no charge. /wboils shows your saved mode; on/off/toggle changes it. The exhausted portion is consumed without returning a bottle, as before.
